profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Antech Diagnostics
profile.summary:
I am a Principal Software Engineer focused on designing and building microservice architectures with an AI first approach for large scale corporate systems. These systems account for scalability, security, performance, separation of responsibility, observability, and transaction processing. 

A secondary area of expertise is in designing build pipelines. I have improved build pipeline performance by a factor of 10 with the introduction of parallel processing to the pipelines. I have also parameterized builds to allow for single step selection and rapid redeployment of selected services.

At Oracle, I have embraced AI with agentic programming using the Plan and Act phases of the company approved IDE plugin Cline and GPT5 models. I also built a MCP Server using Helidon MCP to query Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Log Analytics and feed the logs to GPT5 to determine the status of file processing for customers.

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description: Provide next generation solutions to clients through the use of artificial intelligence, cloud based technologies, and mobile solutions.

positions.title: Principal Application Engineer
positions.description:
●	Designed and built REST and Event Driven Microservices using Java 25 and Spring Boot and the Helidon framework for My Oracle Support (MOS) Application hosted in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Contributed to Service Request file attachment workflow features. Applied Domain Driven Design principles.
●	Developed an AI Agent that provides interactive feedback to the user inquiring about the status of an uploaded file to a service request. This agent was orchestrated with Langgraph to use RAG to retrieve workflow documentation, and MCP Servers to query the database and use the OCI LogAnalytics API to extract relevant logs to the file status.
●	Presented AI solutions to the department VP and to the cross-department developer Brown Bag group, including AI-generated Sequence Diagrams, Agents using RAG, Tools, and MCP Servers.
●	Mentored Junior Developers on complex software tasks related to Helidon APIs, java virtual threads, and Oracle Streaming Service integrations.
●	Used Codex AI coding agent with GPT5 models to implement the Plan/Act phases for development. 
●	Architected a Failover MicroService using Java virtual threads to retry failed API calls and provide fallback and workflow continuation.
●	Improved enkins pipeline deployment times by 90% by introducing parallel builds and isolation of single microservice restarts.
●	Automated the rotation of application secrets using the Python OCI APIs for the Cloud Vault.
●	Prompt-Engineered a dashboard to implement Trivy scans for docker images.

positions.title: Principal Application Developer
positions.description: Designed and built REST and Event Driven Microservices using Python, Spring Boot and the Helidon framework for My Oracle Support (MOS) Application hosted as a native cloud application. Applied Domain Driven Design principles to port legacy application to Cloud Native microservices. Developed AI Agents that provides interactive feedback to the user inquiring about the status of an uploaded file to a service request. This agent was orchestrated with LangGraph to use RAG to retrieve workflow documentation, and MCP Servers to query the database and use the OCI Log Analytics API to extract relevant logs to the file status. Transformed wireframes from proof of concept to production dashboards using React framework. Mentored Junior Developers on complex software tasks related to Helidon APIs, AI development concepts, java virtual threads, and Oracle Streaming Service integrations. Used Codex AI coding agent with GPT5 models for accelerated spec driven development and context engineering. Architected a Failover MicroService using Java virtual threads to retry failed API calls and provide fallback and workflow continuation. Improved Jenkins pipeline deployment times by 90% by introducing parallel builds and isolation of single microservice restarts. Automated the rotation of application secrets using the Python OCI APIs for the Cloud Vault.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description: Skills: Code Coverage · Unit Testing · Debugging · Code Review · Web Applications · Design Documents · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · Spring MVC · Spring Security · Oracle SQL Developer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●        Received a promotion from Senior Software Developer to Technical Lead Developer. Served as tech lead from scrum team and later as tech lead for the entire organization.
●        Developed microservices for DaVita physician workflows using Spring Boot2, Spring Data, Restful Web Services, Spring Gateway, Eureka, and Spring Cloud messaging via Kafka.
●        Led migration of Legacy Patient Scheduling application to an event-driven Spring Boot microservices on AWS (EventBridge, ECS Fargate, PostgreSQL + DynamoDB, Terraform, 
●        Drive migration of legacy application to cloud native application hosted on AWS.
●        Provided Architectural design for new business initiatives including integration with 3rd party software and interoperability with internal software groups. Delegated design work to other developers and provided formal approval for the designs.
●        Established best practices across the development teams for code quality (Sonarqube), test coverage (Jacoco and SonarQube), api documentation (Swagger), rest endpoint design, and data modeling (Spring Data, Jolt, MapStruct, and JsonViews).
●        Built framework level code in reusable libraries to be included across microservices such as Auditing Framework and Dafka Retry Workflow.
●        Enhanced features for UI using Angular 10 Components, Services, Directives, and Modules.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Java software development providing prevention services. Technologies used include: JBoss, Hibernate, Struts, SQL Server, Design Patterns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Provided web-based patient care solutions using Struts, Spring MVC, Backbone.js, and BootStrap CSS to assist physicians and medical staff identify and care for critical segments of their population in an agile environment. Directed Junior Developers and Interns to develop to requirements specifications using an Agile Process. Received CARE project of the year award for delivering IVR, web notifications, and mailers to high-risk members of the population for flu season. Innovated open-source solutions with ETL through the data layer and the JEE Server Middle Tier to the front end with a software stack including Ajax, Restful Web Services, SOAP Web Services, JSPs, and Thymeleaf templates.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Website developer for two customer facing websites using Java technologies.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and enhanced customer-facing web applications using the Struts framework on Weblogic servers for customer account maintenance site and shopping cart application to attract new customers. Led a team of 5 developers on quarterly promotions projects intricate to Dish Network’s plans for increasing revenue and the customer base.
